chronicle.text: Baihaim came back for food left 21 weeks before, and it was still there.
Kaizou drank from the sea and it did not quench their thirst.
Baihaim scratched a mark <^^.> into wood.
Naiza struck flint where dry things lay, and they caught: the first fire made by people.
Naiza struck flint with stone and stared at what happened.
Naiza struck flint with stone and was left with a sharp edge: the first blade.
Baihaim went back to what they had left in one spot a third time, to see it happen again: the first deliberate testing.
Zeigeisouk gathered food that had grown where seeds had been dropped: the first harvest from seed left in the ground.
Baihaim set food aside on purpose, having found it there when it was needed before: the beginning of keeping stores.
Leiveitoul found that what Theivoutek had told them was wrong, and trusted them less for it.
Zeigeisouk tied wood and wood together with fiber and was left with something that floats and carries someone across water: the first raft.
Duyan tied fiber and fiber together with fiber and was left with something to carry things in: the first carrier.
Thibodam told Daitairam that Nethaik could be believed: reputation passed on by word.
Relem buried seed on purpose, having seen it come back as food: the beginning of farming.
Naiza tied a blade and wood together with fiber and was left with a sharp point on a long shaft: the first spear.
Baihaim tied a bundle they had tied and wood together with fiber and was left with something heavy on a handle: the first club.
Zeigeisouk crossed open water on something that floats and came ashore on land nobody could walk to from where they set out.
Dubos attacked Neilo: the first violence.
At (12, 21) the heap of things people had left grew big enough to keep out a fifth of the winter cold: the first dwelling. Baihaim had put in the most.
Neilo killed Dubos after being attacked by Dubos in year 4.
Revenge answered revenge: the feud between the kin of Neilo and the kin of Dubos had begun.
Neilo crossed open water on something that floats and came ashore on land nobody could walk to from where they set out.
Deiken tied a club and fiber together with fiber and was left with something warm to wear: the first wrap.
Daideik came on the mark <o^v> and took it to mean seed sown in autumn: the first mark read as a message.
Zeigeisouk took up striking stone with flint from a mark: the first thing learned from a record.
6 people now take the mark </o-> to go with stone being struck, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.

The mark <\o|> has drifted: it went with a grave, and now, for 4 people, with shelter.
Daideik found that what the mark <o^v> seemed to say was wrong, and put less faith in that mark.
3 people now take the mark <\.o> to go with water, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.

A hungry year: 4 people starved after a poor growing season.

Years 0-24: population 20 to 19, 24 births. Deaths mostly from starvation (9), thirst (7), illness (6). Average happiness 0.76. Recorded: 6 inventions, 18 firsts, 1 revenge killings, 1 famines, 13 band changes, 5 new exchange partnerships, 5 new settlements.
3 people now tell that Kudou stole from Duyan. It was Kizelis. The story changed as it was passed on.
Yegunoun fed wood to a fire to keep it going: the first kept fire.
